title: Michel O. Maceda Memorial Act
official_summary:
Michel O. Maceda Memorial Act

This act designates the Air and Marine Operations Marine Unit of the U.S. Customs and Border Protection located  at 101 Km 18.5 in Cabo Rojo, Puerto Rico, as the Michel O. Maceda Marine Unit.

summary.headline: Names a U.S. Customs and Border Protection marine unit in Cabo Rojo, Puerto Rico, after Michel O. Maceda.
summary.what_it_does: This law officially names the Air and Marine Operations Marine Unit of U.S. Customs and Border Protection, located at 101 Km 18.5 in Cabo Rojo, Puerto Rico, as the Michel O. Maceda Marine Unit.
